approved: Owner approval in conversation, 2026-11-23 (after the O0 reproduction miss and the test evaluation had been seen).
class: Amendment within the same Worklog: non-scientific execution correction of the O0 reproduction qualification rule. No hypothesis, arm, metric, threshold of any angular / scene rule, or measured value changes.
trigger: O0 (8-start batch) vs archived WL104K P (4-start batch), final training objective per unit, starts 1-4: 24 / 36 units above 1e-4 relative, 2 above 1e-2 (test83_iid_0 start 1 +4.84e-2, test83_block_186 start 2 -1.82e-2). Step-0 objectives are identical; trajectories differ from step 100 on. Under the frozen rule (> 1e-2 -> UNQUALIFIED) every angular label is UNQUALIFIED (test_eval/test.json, unchanged and preserved).
suspected_cause: Not verified before this amendment: GPU floating-point reduction-order differences (batch size 8 vs 4, run-to-run atomics) amplified chaotically by a non-convex fit; the code path was shown identical to WL104K (pre-fit contracts: objective at WL104K states equal to 0.0; Adam path bitwise equal to fit104k.train for 50 steps).

measurement.reruns: Same code (fit104kb.py, adam / original data / original objective, 12,000 steps, protocol starts): R4a and R4b = the WL104K configuration (starts 1-4, batch of 4 starts, 36 units), R8 = the O0 configuration (8 starts, 72 units). Outputs under <root>/amendment1/fits/{R4a,R4b,R8}.
measurement.pairs: Per-unit relative difference |f_x - f_y| / |f_y| of the final training objective for the same-method comparisons: run-to-run at batch 4 (R4a vs archive, R4b vs archive, R4a vs R4b; 36 units each), run-to-run at batch 8 (R8 vs O0; 72 units), batch-size change (R8 starts 1-4 vs R4a and vs R4b; 36 units each). Each component is reported separately; the pooled rerun distribution is their union.
measurement.target: O0 vs archived WL104K P (36 units, starts 1-4).

criterion: NONDETERMINISM_CONSISTENT iff (i) max_units |rel|(O0 vs archive) <= 2 x max |rel|(pooled reruns) AND (ii) the 95th percentile of |rel|(O0 vs archive) <= 2 x the 95th percentile of |rel|(pooled reruns). Factor 2 is predeclared because two reruns sample the extremes poorly. Otherwise NOT_CONSISTENT.
consequence: NONDETERMINISM_CONSISTENT: the O0 reproduction qualification is replaced by this result; labels are qualified with the disclosed flag O0_REPRODUCTION_DISCREPANCY (label = measured label, + CONTROL_NOT_DEMONSTRATED where the protocol adds it, + O0_REPRODUCTION_DISCREPANCY), all other qualifications unchanged. NOT_CONSISTENT: labels stay UNQUALIFIED. In both cases the original-rule decision (decision.json from test_eval/test.json) is kept and the amended decision is written separately (amendment1/decision_amendment1.json from amendment1/test_amended.json).
